decisions.reason: The black-finish range is a surface variant of Dallmer's core drainage know-how and fits the established black bathroom concept, and it was moved up to its own page in 2024, so the firm can read the early results and keep refining the line cheaply.

CeraFrame Liquid builds directly on the firm's shower channel engineering for seamless, barrier-free bathrooms, a core strategic direction, and it has stayed on its own page for two years, which points to sustained commitment.

Pump technology is less central to the firm's knowledge base, and the earlier pump line C was dropped, but F looks like the absorbed lessons from C recombined with core shower channel expertise, so it deserves time to prove itself in the barrier-free renovation segment.
